name: yachtly-tz-relay
description: Read-only relay that converts TimeZero's UDP NMEA 0183 output to Signal K WebSocket deltas for Yachtly Connect.

scripts.binaries: npm run bundle && pkg build/yachtly-helper.cjs --targets node20-win-x64,node20-macos-arm64,node20-macos-x64 --out-path binaries --compress GZip
scripts.binaries:mac-arm64: npm run bundle && pkg build/yachtly-helper.cjs --targets node20-macos-arm64 --output binaries/yachtly-connect-helper-mac-arm64
